one_liner: Capital OS is an investor intelligence platform that helps founders discover, research, track, and build relationships with the right investors to raise funding.
description: Capital OS helps startups and founders navigate the fundraising process by bringing investor discovery, intelligence, and relationship management into one platform. Founders can discover relevant investors, access structured investor profiles, evaluate investment preferences, track fundraising opportunities, manage outreach, and organize their entire fundraising pipeline. By combining investor data, intelligent matching, research, and workflow tools, Capital OS makes it easier for founders to identify the right funding opportunities, make informed decisions, and build meaningful investor relationships.
differentiator: Unlike traditional CRMs and fragmented investor databases, Capital OS combines investor discovery, structured intelligence, relevance-based matching, and fundraising relationship management in one purpose-built platform. Instead of simply providing lists of investors, Capital OS helps founders understand who to approach, why they are relevant, and how to manage relationships throughout the fundraising journey.
target_customer: Early-stage startup founders, solo founders, entrepreneurs, and startup teams seeking angel investment, pre-seed, seed, and venture capital funding. Secondary customers include startup accelerators, incubators, venture studios, and ecosystem organizations supporting founders with fundraising and investor connections.
